title: Graph Engineering reflection record
description: One attempt of a rubric-bound, bounded reflection. Reflection compares a producer output to the exact rubric and emits structured issues, evidence, suggested changes and a verdict; it is not open-ended self-critique. acceptedResultHash always equals subjectHash, so the accepted result is never silently edited: a revision is a proposal carried separately as proposedResultHash. Exactly the last record of a chain stops, with a reason drawn from a closed six-member vocabulary.

reflectionId.description: SHA-256 over frame('graphengineering.reflection.v1alpha1') || frame(runId) || frame(nodeId) || frame(decimal(attempt)) || frame(canonicalSerialize(record without reflectionId)).

rubricHash.description: Identical across every record of a chain. A rubric that changes mid-chain is RUBRIC_DRIFT.

subjectHash.description: The exact producer output under review, preserved unchanged on this record.

acceptedResultHash.description: Must equal subjectHash on every record. Reflection never silently edits the accepted result.

proposedResultHash.description: Present iff verdict is 'reject', and never equal to subjectHash. The successor record's subjectHash is this value.

attempt.description: Runs 1..revisionsMax + 1 and is contiguous and strictly increasing across a chain. Every attempt is recorded.

verdict.description: Three members. A reflection cannot abstain from its own rubric.

issues.description: In rubric criterion declaration order. Each issue's basis must equal its criterion's basis.

deterministicChecks.description: Covers exactly the rubric criteria whose basis is 'deterministic', in rubric declaration order, and no other. This is the separation of deterministic checks from model judgment, made mechanical.

modelJudgment.description: Whether the same model and the same context are permitted is a declared permission that must equal the rubric's, never an inference.

stopReason.description: Present iff stopped is true. Closed six-member vocabulary with exact conditions; 'unknown-evidence' terminates reflection rather than licensing another lap.
